verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills is a packaging/extension mechanism consumed by an agent (Claude Code/Claude API), not a standalone service meant to be connected to as an MCP server by other agents. Evidence shows Claude Code connecting OUT to MCP servers and plugins optionally bundling MCP servers as one component type, but nothing shows Skills itself exposed as an MCP server endpoint for external agents to connect to — this is a category mismatch (client-side agent feature, not a server axis).
